MUSLOOP.Title: musloop desk
MUSLOOP.NoTracks: No tracks yet. Export a track from musloop with “Files → Foundry VTT (zip)” and import it here.
MUSLOOP.ImportZipHint: Pick a *_foundry.zip exported by musloop. Files are uploaded to Data/musloop/<track>/.
MUSLOOP.Pick: pick a scene or a part
MUSLOOP.GMOnly: Only the GM controls the music.
MUSLOOP.Setting.VolumeHint: Local volume for musloop playback. The GM's cue timing is shared; volume is per player.
MUSLOOP.Setting.TailsHint: Let the previous section ring out ~1 s over the new one (uses *_tail.wav if present).
MUSLOOP.PacksHint: Ready-made tracks (Creative Commons) — install with one click
MUSLOOP.PacksIntro: Free, properly licensed tracks already cut into loops with musloop. Installing downloads one track to Data/musloop/ on this server; players need nothing. Credit the artists in your game notes (CC-BY).
MUSLOOP.Setting.PackSourcesHint: Additional pack index URLs (one per line or space-separated). The official index is always included.
MUSLOOP.ClickToHear: musloop: click anywhere in Foundry to hear the music.
